text_block_list.text:
When I came over for lunch...
—an awful, terrible stench drifted over!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! It is finished!
As expected of me! As expected of the Class President!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: For I have created such a truly maaaaagnificent sandwich...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*cough* *cough*, it smells burnt...!
Bakushin O-san, are you alright?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! My fellow honor student, Flower-san!
Everything is A-OK! Turned out to absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then, is that charcoal-look—... N-No.
Did you make that dish... Bakushin O-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
The sandwich filling... boiled eggs!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With this perfect, Bakushin-style cooking,
I can certainly show appreciation to everyone in class...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-style... cooking, you say?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
Speed is essential in cooking, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Extra oil so the heat gets through fast!
Finish off with high-heat fire, and the boiled egg is complete!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: How about that?! Absolutely flawless, wouldn't you say!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: B-Boiled e—... Y-Yes... I see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
S-Speed is important, right!
Warm food is delicious, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But, um...
Cooking isn't just about speed, or rather...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What?! Not just about that, you say...?! 
However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No... I see, I seeeeee!!
I understand now! Completely! Perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew... What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Simply dashing forward isn't enough... In other words!
I must bakushin even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I shall remake it right away!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Throwing everything into the frying pan all at once!!
And then high heat... Nay! Explosive fireball fire!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, wait! That's not what I meant,
it's better to follow the recipe—
(KABOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh no...!
Are you hurt...?!
